text:
leo: Hey, accepted org invite but when I try to push over SSH I get "Permission denied (publickey)" even though I added my key. Anyone?

sam: Welcome! Quick checks: is the key in your GitHub profile the same one on ~/.ssh/id_ed25519.pub? Also make sure ssh-agent is running and key is loaded.

leo: Yep same key. Agent shows it loaded. I can ssh -T git@github.com and it says authenticated as leo-dev but push to repo redwood/tools shows forbidden (403).

ops-bot: Onboarding note: leo (leo@redwood.ai) 1 SSO pending. SSH key present. Flagging for team sync if SSO confirmed.

tara: If ssh auth works but push is forbidden, likely a team membership/permission issue. Are you in tools-team? I don't see that mapping for leo-dev, maybe invite used a different alias. @sam can re-run team-sync.

sam: I re-ran the team sync and added leo-dev to tools-team with write permissions. Also ensured SSO is accepted for leo@redwood.ai. Try pushing now.

leo: Push succeeded, PR opened. Thanks! Noted that SSO acceptance still shows pending for a short bit after invite 1 will watch for that.

ops-bot: Logged follow-up: update onboarding doc to include SSH auth + SSO race note (ticket ONB-99).
